notes: Fixes Clear All My Data and Log Out actually doing nothing when tapped: it was calling the database wipe directly on the main thread, which Room silently rejects, so the whole operation died before any cleanup ran. Now runs off the main thread like every other file/database operation in the app. This is a different bug from the earlier watermark fix - that one is still in place too, so a full clear now correctly wipes everything, resets SMS scanning, and signs out of Family in one go.
